# AMD FidelityFX API headers

`api/include/ffx_api.h`, `api/include/ffx_api_types.h` and
`upscalers/include/ffx_upscale.h` are vendored unchanged from the AMD
FidelityFX SDK, tag `v2.3.0`, revision
`60f4ea81909200d8542eca14dccb2628b763a9a3`.

Source:
https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK/tree/60f4ea81909200d8542eca14dccb2628b763a9a3/Kits/FidelityFX

The SDK's `Kits/FidelityFX/docs/license.md` lists these files under the MIT
license, which is also printed at the beginning of each header. Only the API
declarations are used. The FidelityFX runtime DLLs are the game's own; they are
not built or distributed by this source tree.
